message: Replaced DB::raw interpolation with safe increment/decrement calls to avoid SQL injection and keep atomic updates.
Added structured warnings when lockForUpdate fails and avoided silent fallback.
Replaced comment-only catch with a warning log to surface logging failures during tests or production.
Added migration to create indexes for `game_player_icons` and `game_properties` to address missing-index warnings.
Multiple unauthenticated POST routes exist for guest flows under /join/{token}/... — acceptable if token is sole credential, but requires a security review to confirm token strength and expiry.
